name: X (Twitter)
description: Read X: user profiles, recent posts, search. Post with a write-capable sign-in.
help: Two ways in. FAST READS: paste a Bearer Token from developer.x.com (reads need at least Basic tier). FULL ACCESS (post + reads): create an app at developer.x.com, paste its Client ID below, press Connect and approve in the browser. Posting always asks your approval first.

fields.label: Client secret (only if your X app is confidential)
